categories.main_business_segments: Core Corporation operates three main business segments: Future Society Solutions (addressing social and environmental issues with high-value-added solutions), Industrial Technology Solutions (providing IoT, AI, and GNSS-based ICT solutions for industrial clients), and Customer Business Integration (offering comprehensive ICT services leveraging business knowledge and expertise for client operations).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced ICT technologies, including IoT, AI, and GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System), as well as proprietary frameworks for software development. It emphasizes standardization of development knowledge, integration of AI for data utilization, and high-precision 3D data management systems for infrastructure and logistics applications. Production involves both in-house development and strategic outsourcing to partner companies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Core Corporation serves a diverse range of customers, including government agencies, municipalities, manufacturers, logistics and transportation companies, financial institutions, and healthcare providers. Its solutions target public sector digitalization, industrial automation, logistics efficiency, and medical IT transformation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Japan, with a nationwide network of regional companies and offices. Over 90% of its revenue and assets are derived from domestic operations, with no significant overseas presence reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Core Corporation is positioned as a midstream to downstream player in the ICT value chain, acting as a solution integrator and service provider. It develops, integrates, and delivers software and ICT solutions directly to end-users and enterprise clients, while also managing some upstream technology development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on being a 'Social Solution Maker' by leveraging ICT to solve societal challenges and drive sustainability transformation (SX). R&D priorities include AI-driven data utilization, cloud-based platforms, next-generation media solutions, high-precision GNSS/space tech, and medical DX. The company is also investing in upskilling personnel and expanding its solution lineup through innovation and M&A.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based software development, system integration, and solution sales, with additional income from maintenance, licensing, and some recurring service contracts. The company recognizes revenue based on project progress (percentage-of-completion) and product delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Core Corporation competes with other independent Japanese ICT solution providers and system integrators, as well as divisions of major electronics and IT conglomerates. It differentiates itself as an independent, end-user-focused solution provider with a strong regional presence and expertise in both public and industrial sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 24.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 3.2 billion yen and net profit of 2.2 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth (2-3% annual sales increase), high equity ratio (73.6%), and aims for further expansion, targeting 27 billion yen in sales for FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Core Corporation emphasizes its ability to deliver high-value, customized ICT solutions that address complex social and industrial challenges. Its unique value lies in combining advanced proprietary technologies (AI, GNSS, IoT), deep domain expertise, and a flexible, regionally rooted organizational structure, enabling close customer engagement and rapid, innovative problem-solving.
